d: Earthly hall of the Louvre. On the left magnificent staircase that puts in the king's apartments; another similar to straight, driver to those of the queen; side doors: in the intercolumnium bottom, crossed by seriche, effigy curtains. Start the night; burn vague doubles. Knights and Dame, coming from different parts.
Chalais.
Maria, from the apartments of the palace, is said.
De Fiesque, the Visconte, Dame, Knights and said. So an Exhibitor.
Gondi and sayings; then Chalais.
Chevreuse and sayings.
Mary and sayings.
The Viscount and sayings.

A room in the Chalais palace. On the right at the bottom, entrance door: on the left open veronas from which I glimpsed a façade of the Louvre, all illuminated; on the side the door of an armored cabinet, adorned with trophies: against it other door that puts at the apartment of the Countess, mother of Chalais. Chalais, busy writing; on the table, a light sword to which he will seal the letters. Aubry in the bottom. Odesi from the Louvre the sound of happy dances.
Aubry is said.
The above, and Mary closed in dominoes and covered in a mask.
Chevreuse is said.
Mary is said; she is pale, and she is ill standing.
The above, and the Viscount, always inside.

Room in the home of Chevreuse. Entrance into the façade; a side door; large opening at the bottom; a small table between two chairs. Chevreuse, with an arm wrapped in a blindfold, sits at the coffee table, on which stand the guns of Chalais. Mary standing on one side, Chalais on the other, some Servants back.
A Chevreuse family, Aubry and sayings.
Chevreuse, and sayings.
Chevreuse, it is said; then the Family.
De Fiesque, in military uniform, some Archers, who remain beyond the entrance, and sayings.
Fiesque is said; then the Family.
Mary and the Family, then Chevreuse.
The opening of the door suddenly appeared Chalais; the above.
The family, and sayings.
The door at the bottom is knocked down: they break into the hall De Fiesque and a company of Archers.

I opened the side door, from which Chevreuse is shown, whose appearances are distorted: he has straight hair on his forehead, and the eye shining with blood light: so much that better than man you would believe horrible spectre.
